claim: For the posterior-covariance Gaussian field observed after the linear SNR channel sqrt(gamma) B X + G, the double scale integral over T and gamma is bounded by (J_L/4) log det(I + Gamma B Cov(X) B*).
scope_limit: N75 field and profile definitions are absent; this corollary applies only when A_gamma = B Cov(X|Y_gamma) B*.
